boundaries.training_missingness: TRAIN only; natural unknown_code, missing, and default_code statuses; positive training weight from profile v2
boundaries.test_support: Recorded TEST support counts only; target labels were not read
boundaries.source_interpretation: Scorer is a source-behavior proxy, not an independent acquisition source or proof of source absence

limitations: Fractional scorer weights allocate multi-scorer games and are not integer event counts.
Threshold coverage means a matching scorer-decade has at least 500 weighted recorded TEST events and 50 recorded TEST games; failure to meet it is not source absence.
Empirical masking preserves observed labels and therefore does not reproduce the historical target-label selection mechanism.
The support calculation does not reproduce result-family covariate shift between observed and naturally unknown targets.
